raw_definitions: Definisi : on the side of the ~s, menyebelahi pihak yg benar. (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)

Definisi : n 1. divine attendant, messenger, malaikat; ~ of death, malaikat maut; 2. guardian spirit , malaikat; 3. conventional representation of such beings, patung bidadari; 4. innocent, lovely person, spt bidadari; 5. obliging, kind, loving person, baik hati; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
